name: cobalix-orbital
description: Cobalix Orbital — Local-first AI-assisted cybersecurity and file intelligence platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspace=packages/scanners && npm run build --workspace=packages/ai && npm run build --workspace=packages/agents && npm run build --workspace=apps/companion && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:companion:bundle && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npx tauri build --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles app
scripts.build:desktop:x64: npm run build && npm run build:companion:bundle && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npx tauri build --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles app
scripts.build:desktop:arm64: npm run build && npm run build:companion:bundle && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npx tauri build --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app
scripts.build:desktop:x64:bundled: npm run build && npm run build:companion:bundle && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npx tauri build --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.bundled-runtime.conf.json --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles app
scripts.build:desktop:arm64:bundled: npm run build && npm run build:companion:bundle && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" npx tauri build --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.bundled-runtime.conf.json --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app
